👋 Welcome to the Jujutsu Kaisen Character Quiz!

Do you really know every sorcerer and curse from JJK?
Test your memory and guess characters by their appearance!

🖼️ Look at the character image
🎹 Type the correct name
✅ Correct answer = unlock the next stage
❌ Wrong answer = try again

💡 Hint system: letters will reveal over time while you stay on the stage.

🏆 Try to reach the top of the leaderboard and prove you’re a true JJK fan!

⭐ Like & Favorite to support the game and future updates!
